question: Ascent, 4v4, 42s. Your team controls B Main + Catwalk. One confirmed DEF anchoring B Site. You are KAY/O (ZERO/point, Flash, Frag/ment). How do you execute the B Site take?

options.label: Throw ZERO/point on B Site to suppress the anchor's util, then flash the entry and push through
options.explication_courte: The suppression knife strips the anchor's util (denies smokes, mollys, any retaliatory abilities), the flash blinds them, and grouped entry clears the site cleanly.

options.label: Flash the B Site entry directly and push without the knife, save ZERO/point for a future use
options.explication_courte: Flash plus entry is a valid execute and saves the knife, but it leaves the anchor with full util intact - they may flash or molly back during your push.

sources_option.citation: Flash-and-enter is a solid execute, but suppressing the anchor's utility first denies the delay tools they use to contest your plant.

options.label: Throw Frag/ment on the anchor's known spot to deal damage before the entry, without flashing
options.explication_courte: The molly alone displaces the anchor but without a flash you enter into an open duel: the anchor repositions and waits with full sight.

sources_option.citation: A molly displaces a holder but a dry entry without a flash still gives them a clean duel from a repositioned angle; layer your utility.

options.label: Dry-push B Site with your teammate without using any util to surprise the anchor with speed
options.explication_courte: Dry-entry against a confirmed anchor when you have a full execute kit wastes all your util; the anchor takes the time advantage and holds the angle freely.

sources_option.citation: Executing a site with utility makes defenders choose between bad options; a dry entry against a prepared anchor hands them the opening duel.

explication_longue:
Situation: Ascent, 4v4, 42 seconds. Your team controls B Main + Catwalk. One DEF confirmed anchoring B Site (E1 visible). You are KAY/O with ZERO/point (suppression knife), Flash-drive, Frag/ment.

A confirmed anchor on a site you control means the execute is yours to take. KAY/O's optimal execute sequence for a single anchor: (1) throw ZERO/point onto B Site to suppress all their abilities, (2) flash the entry immediately after the knife lands, (3) push grouped while the flash is active and the anchor has no util to retaliate.

The suppression knife is KAY/O's strongest execute tool: it silences smokes, mollys, trips, and any defensive abilities the anchor might use to survive the push. Flash alone (acceptable) also works and saves the knife for later, but leaves the anchor with full util. Frag/ment alone (costly) displaces without blinding - the anchor repositions with full sight. Dry-push (mistake) concedes every advantage to the anchor.

Estimated elite distribution: ~54% knife+flash+push, ~22% flash only then push, ~17% molly alone (costly), ~5% dry-push (mistake).

sources.citation: Good executes compress defender decision-making by using good utility to make defenders choose between bad options.
Layer utility: a flash sets up the entry, a trade ensures the duel isn't isolated, and suppression/mollies deny the holder's delay tools.
When your first player swings with support utility and a second close enough to trade, the defender no longer gets a free 1v1 even if the entry dies.

_gaps.incertitude: Knife-now (optimal) vs garder ZERO/point pour le retake (acceptable) depend du plan d'equipe et de la valeur du knife en post-plant sur Ascent ; certains KAY/O gardent le knife pour l'ult/retake. Contexte de manche non fixe.
Un seul anchor B est confirme ; les 3 autres DEF sont inconnus. Si un 2e DEF stack B, le poids de la suppression augmente ; s'ils sont A, l'execute passe plus vite. Non encode.
Estimations depuis guides execute/trade (boosteria, theguide, alviran) ; pas de dataset sur la frequence knife-first vs flash-first en execute B Ascent par elo.
